bullets.text: AI-Ready Data Revolution - **Microsoft** introduces new **Fabric** capabilities to enhance AI readiness across organizations.
Spec-Driven Development Unveiled - **GitHub** launches Spec Kit to streamline AI-driven software development workflows.
Azure Storage Performance Boost - **Azure Container Storage** v2.0.0 delivers up to 7x higher IOPS for Kubernetes workloads.
Windows 11 Updates Released - New builds for **Windows 11** bring features like AI actions and improved user experiences.
Interoperability Commitments Announced - **Microsoft** outlines new commitments to enhance interoperability for **Teams** and **Microsoft 365**.
Developer Accessibility Enhanced - Individual developers can now publish apps to the **Microsoft Store** without fees.
AI-Powered Conversational Commerce - **Ralph Lauren** introduces Ask Ralph, an AI styling companion for personalized shopping.
